bool VSZoomEnabled() {
  return base::CommandLine::InitializedForCurrentProcess() &&
      base::CommandLine::ForCurrentProcess()->HasSwitch("versanium-zoom-fullscreen-diagnostics");
}
std::ostringstream VSZoomFields() {
  std::ostringstream fields;
  fields << std::setprecision(17);
  return fields;
}
void VSZoomLog(const char* event, const std::string& scope, const std::string& fields) {
  if (!VSZoomEnabled()) return;
  struct Entry { std::string key; std::string last; unsigned changes = 0; };
  static thread_local std::array<Entry, 32> entries;
  static thread_local unsigned next = 0;
  static thread_local uint64_t sequence = 0;
  const std::string key = std::string(event) + ":" + scope;
  Entry* entry = nullptr;
  for (auto& item : entries) if (item.key == key) { entry = &item; break; }
  if (!entry) { entry = &entries[next++ % entries.size()]; *entry = Entry{key, "", 0}; }
  if (entry->last == fields || entry->changes > 64) return;
  entry->last = fields;
  if (entry->changes++ == 64) {
    LOG(INFO) << "VSZOOMFS event=DIAGNOSTIC_LIMIT scope=" << scope << " dropped_event=" << event;
    return;
  }
  LOG(INFO) << "VSZOOMFS event=" << event << " seq=" << ++sequence
            << " seq_scope=module_thread tick_us="
            << base::TimeTicks::Now().since_origin().InMicroseconds() << " " << fields;
}
